description: Defines the SessionTerminalManager class which manages VS Code terminals for agent sessions, handling creation, display, and disposal of terminals based on session state and workspace context.

classes.name: SessionTerminalManager
classes.description: Manages VS Code terminals for agent sessions, including creation, display, and cleanup based on session state and workspace context.

methods.name: showTerminal
methods.description: Shows or creates a terminal for a given session, setting its cwd based on session type and workspace.

methods.name: showOrCreateTerminal
methods.description: Creates a new terminal or shows an existing one for a session, handling terminal lifecycle and updates.

methods.name: closeTerminal
methods.description: Closes and disposes the terminal associated with a session.

methods.name: showExistingTerminal
methods.description: Reveals an existing terminal for a session if it is active.

methods.name: hasTerminal
methods.description: Checks if a session has an active terminal.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of all resources and optionally closes all terminals.
